GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced well back Two Wide (7L from lead). Stayed well back Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide @ 600m. Chasing 3 Wide @ 500m & Four Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & ground home steadily in last 150m. # Solid from rear.
Jumped Ok pressed on to lead 2 Lengths clear, under pressure turn and dropped out # led too quick
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding settling further forward, rdr stated whilst he had been instructed to help the gelding begin and muster, he had not anticipated leading. He said that from the wide barrier, after riding his mount along in the early  stages, he observed runners to his inside holding their position, therefore he elected  to continue to press forward to avoid being caught wide and obtained the lead near the 1600m. He added that the gelding travelled comfortably in the lead, however, came  under pressure near the 500m before weakening in the early part of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat last 11l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Lost ground at the start when badly crowded.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Straight Out The Back 10 Lengths No Pace On = task out 3 Wide 800m 8 Lengths Ridden Along Turning for home sprint home (t/t/off) # couldn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Near the 800m was shifted out after becoming awkwardly placed close to heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled Mid Field rails 6 Lengths 1000m, Ridden Along getting off fence before the corner, did keep grinding away last 200m and finished Just out of placings, blinkers again, winkers off first time # grinding placing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re riding, rdr std passing the 800m, whilst in a trailing position, his mnt commenced to travel keenly & became awkwardly placed close to heels as the pace slowed, & he was unable to shift wider due to a rnr on his outside. Std his mnt then became awkwardly placed near the 700m & remained held up until nearing the 400m. Added after placing mnt under pressure it commenced to improve but was obliged to check & shift wider, & after gaining clear running near the 300m it finished race off well but was unable to erode the margin. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Straight Out The Back Settled Down rea Inside 8 Lengths , Ridden Along 500 same, clear run home kept trying without threatening (w/1st) # not quick enough
Jumped Ok drifted back 8l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on one pace # back/no run on
